newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley ups Orange.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan Stanley ups Orange.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Orange Plc climbed on Wednesday as analysts at Morgan Stanley upgraded their recommendation on the stock to "outperform" from "neutral" with a price target of 235p.
The shares were up three pence at 210 by 0754 GMT.
Earlier, Orange said the subscriber base for its wirefree netwrok rose 109,000 to 894,000 in the first quarter of 1997.
It said churn had stayed in line with expectations, at a rate of 19.1 percent over the last 12 months.

"The first quarter inspires confidence that the company is going from strength to strength," Morgan Stanley analyst Paul Marsch said. "It makes our full year forecasts look very achievable, and we're very pleased that the churn rate is relatively benign."
